mapper.sql: SELECT p.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qms_inspection_plan_item i WHERE i.plan_id = p.id) AS item_count FROM qms_inspection_plan p LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = p.material_id
mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM qms_inspection_plan p JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = #{materialId} WHERE p.insp_type = #{type} AND p.status = 1 AND (p.material_id = m.id OR (p.material_id IS NULL AND p.material_category = m.category)) ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.material_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, p.id DESC LIMIT 1
